name: Whirring Bronze Gizmo
label: Quest
description: Whirring Bronze Gizmo: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: My new booth will be a sight to see, yes sir! A sight to see, and... For a lucky few, to touch!
I can already hear the whirring bronze gizmos singing their song of mechanical rapture as patrons step to my booth and test their skill!
Ah... Now I need the gizmos themselves to bring my dream closer to fruition. Please, friend, bring me whirring bronze gizmos... And Darkmoon Faire tickets will be yours!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You brought the gizmos! Wonderful! Even now I can hear their buzzing, whirring chorus in my mind! Oh, when this booth is ready it will be the wonder of the world, mark me!
Here are you tickets, friend. And please enjoy your stay at the Faire!
